book.name: Mark
book.title: Mark Riwana Ahiahina Mark i girugirumiya

content: Yesu au Jerusalem i rui
Tauhi Jerusalem hi tutugheregherei, au Bethphage ma Bethany, Olives oyana au gheregherena ma ana tauvotaghotagho ruwagha i aiparitawanehi,

Ma we nanaꞌarena i riwehi, “Ona nae meyagaina au naota awarina ma marainana au meyagaina ona ruirui, apo donki ghaubona raghiraghitana ma egha aiyaꞌi ita gerugeruiya ona inanai, ona kaiweni ma weka ona neiyai.
We kauwana ona ghohaghohai ma aiyaꞌi ina rau-bayademi da aiwaꞌai aubaina o ghohaghohai, yamna ona riwei, ‘Bada i ghoheghohei, mara tupona ava aubaina ma inapari tawanana meyeiyai.’”
Tauhi hi nae da donki raghiraghitana, metaeta au naona hi inanai ma hi kaiweni.
Taumahiri, hi inanahi ma hipa, “Aiwaꞌi aubaina donkina o kaikaiweni?”
Yesu ponana hi pari-verehi ma tauhi hivi aninehi.
Donki hi naiyei Yesu awarina ma gara au uputuwana hi hesi ma tauna i geru.
Rava maghamaghauhi gara au etanai hita uri ma ghehauhi ai ruguruguna hi yavahehi.
Ma rava ghehauhi etanai hi raveni ma ghehauhi hivi muri ma hi garagarara:

content.text: “Hosanna, viahiꞌahinana, aiyai tauna God wavanei, i neꞌi,

content: Viꞌahiꞌahinana, e nenei da inavi bada me amata David; Hosanna au aidamo.”
Yesu au Jerusalem i rui ma i ghae au temple, aiwaꞌi anatapuna i tuvirevirei ma madegha i kwahakwaha aubaina ana Aposel 12 maitehi hi nae au Bethany.
Yesu kaiyaha i kuvari
Mara tomgheha, tauhi au Bethany da hi ghaeghae au Jerusalem ma Yesu am i hiraghe.
Au uwama ma kaiyaha ana ruguruguna i inanai, i nae da ita inanai, anaꞌanona bo eꞌegha. Kaiyahana ruguruguna ava aubaina ai uwauwa egha ahi mara.
Ana tauvotaghotagho, hi rau-rautanighana ma kaiyahana i kuvari, “Egha meyanai aiyaꞌi anom ina ammeyei!”
Yesu tauvi gimagimara ivi yaghaghana hopunehi
Maranana au Jerusalem hi gheꞌeta ma Yesu au temple i rui ma tauvi gimagimara ivi yaghaghana hopunehi. Mane tausenisihi ma kiu taugimarehi ahi teiboro ma ahi anitughura ivi touvirahi,
ma ivi ghaꞌa da temple au orana egha aiyaꞌi inavi gimagimara.
Viharaharamana ivi kareni ma i riwehi, “God riwana hi girumi da, aꞌu numa yamna pari numana aubaihi

content.text: ma taumi o ghohai da me taudanedanene ahi gabu.”

content: Pirisi ghaeghaehi ma raugagayo tauvi haraharamanahi hi nonori mavi hiraghenana ogatarana hivi kareni, anona tauhi hi rovowei aubaina patara ghaeghaenana ana viharaharamana hi bahebahei.
Aubigai, Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho maitehi Jerusalem hi netawanei.
Kaiyaha i poꞌi
Hubahubanai tauhi hi naenaeme ma kaiyahana hi inanai da i poi.
Peter Yesu ana dede i notai ma i riwei, “Ma inana! Kaiyahana u kuvakuvariya i hiraghe.”
Yesu i pari-beyehi, “God awarina onavi tumaghana.
A ririwana kauwemi, aiyaꞌi da wei oyana ina riwei da inavo mahiri ma ina tawanana meyei au boga ma egha ina nuwahaburu ma aiwaꞌi i yatoyatoniya inavi tumaghanei apo i ririweiya ina tupuwa.
Wei yamna aubaina a riwemi, maranana o rau-raupari ma aiwai ovivi baghei ma ovi tumaghana da o vaini ma aiwai ovivi baghei God ina veremi.

Ma marainana o rau-raupari, maeturaturam ahi ghohaboa awarimi ona nota tawanei, yamnei amam au mara taumi ami ghohaboꞌa ina nota tawanei. Ma ina pa egha ona nota tawanei apo amami au mara egha ami ghohaboꞌa ina nota tawanei.”
Jew babadahi Yesu ana vibada hivi tarapiriyei
Tauhi hi nememei au Jerusalem ma Yesu temple au horana i rui, piripirisi ghaeghaehi, raugagayo tauvi haraharamanahi ma babada ghehauhi hi nei Yesu awarina,
ma hi rau-bayadei, “Aiwaꞌi riwapananei wei ghohahi e ghohaghohahi? Aiyaꞌi riwapanana i verem?”
Yesu i pari-beyehi, “Taꞌu raubayada tagogi ana raubayademi ma ina pa onapari beyeꞌu, yamna ana riwemi da aiwaꞌi riwapananei we ghohahi a ghohaghohai.
Ona riweꞌu, John mepa ana riwapana i vaini da i bababataito: yamna Godei bo ravei?”
Tauhi hivi tarapiri vivira, “Aiwaꞌi tana yatoni? Ina pa tana riwa da Godei; apo ina pa, aiwaꞌi aubaina da John egha otavi tumaghanei?
Ina pa tana riwa da ravei...” Tauhi rava hi rovowehi aubaina rava anataputapuhi hi ririwa da John anina peroveta.
Yamna aubaina tauhi Yesu hi pari-beyei hipa, “Tauai egha ata haramanei.” Yesu tauhi i riwehi, “Yamna aubaina da taꞌu egha ana riwemi, aiwaꞌi riwapananei we kauwahi a kaukauwehi.”

footnotes.text: au naona anona yamna, marina mavi yawahaniai ma muriyai hivi rai da rava hevovo hepahepai ma hevivi egwayauwei.
